entries.c4bbbdca8e1ae779: In its 'Okiden Group Management Vision' announced in April 2026, it sets out as its desired form toward 2050 'EMPOWER ＆ COLLABORATE: Giving Vitality to Okinawa and Co-creating the Future with Stakeholders.' By 2030, it positions the period as the 'Future Foundation Creation Phase,' and its management themes are: stable supply and profitability enhancement for each supply chain, operational reform through AX, promotion of a just transition in the Okinawa area toward decarbonization, and expansion of business domains linked to Okinawa's growth. Toward carbon neutrality by 2050, it has published a transition plan with a medium-term target of a 48% reduction from fiscal 2005 levels by fiscal 2040.
